descriptions.compare: Choose a retrieval method, apply explicit constraints and compare attributed evidence. Inspect why each passage entered or left the context.
descriptions.review: Inspect claims, conflicting values and affected drafts. Image observations are separate from verified source attributes. Review alt text in context and inspect deterministic structured data.
descriptions.connections: A read-only Shopify connection, with visible scopes, synchronization history and delivery health. No catalog publishing takes place here.
descriptions.account: Use an account for membership-based access. The anonymous sandbox remains a separate, temporary demonstration.

common.pending: This capability is not available from the current server. Refresh after the service is configured.
common.error: The service could not complete this action. Try again.
common.deleteWarning: Deleting this source removes its current evidence and invalidates dependent content. Historical retention follows the server policy.
common.confirmDelete: Delete this source and invalidate its dependent content
common.deleted: The source was deleted on the server.
common.permission: Your current role does not authorize this action.
common.workspaceChanged: The active workspace changed. Reload before continuing.

account.passwordHint: Use a unique password with at least 12 characters. Account recovery is not configured; keep your password safely.
account.memberHint: Add an already registered account by email. This does not send an invitation or email.
account.anonymousNote: No account is signed in. Your current fictional catalog is isolated by a temporary browser cookie.
account.registered: Account created. Your workspace is ready.
account.signedIn: Signed in to your account workspace.
account.signedOut: Signed out. Returning to the anonymous sandbox.
account.switched: Active workspace changed. Previous workspace data was cleared from this view.
account.registrationDisabled: Account registration is disabled on this server.
account.security: Access cookies are HttpOnly. Passwords are never saved in this browser's local storage.
account.banner: Signed-in workspace · membership permissions checked on the server · evidence revisions retained · read-only store integration
account.noWorkspace: No active workspace membership. Open Account & team to select or create a workspace.
account.noSessionNote: Sign in to an existing membership workspace or create an account. Temporary workspace capacity does not determine account access.

upload.title: Bring the source, too.
upload.description: Upload a bounded JSON/CSV catalog, a PDF manual or a product image. The server validates content and creates a durable job. Images remain observations, not verified product facts.
upload.tooLarge: This file exceeds the server's upload limit.
upload.unsupported: The server does not accept this file type.
upload.processed: Upload processed. Evidence and job records have been refreshed.
upload.unconfigured: Upload limits are unavailable. Uploading is disabled until the server provides them.
upload.csvHint: CSV names and column order must match the server schema below. Use only material you own or have permission to process.
upload.readError: The browser could not read this file. Choose it again.
upload.catalogScope: Catalog import · no existing product required

jobs.title: Work, with a paper trail.
jobs.description: Server-persisted ingestion and drafting jobs. Retrying requests a bounded retry; it does not discard the original record.
jobs.retried: Retry requested. Current job state was refreshed.
jobs.empty: No durable jobs in this workspace.

versions.title: Every revision has context.
versions.description: Inspect source passages and compare immutable versions. Current product evidence and old draft citations stay distinct.

search.trace: Why this evidence entered the context
search.noTrace: No context trace returned. This response does not prove that an inspector ran.
search.empty: Run a comparison to inspect current evidence.
search.title: Inspect the retrieval decision.
search.description: Compare retrieval methods and constraints against current authorized evidence. Unavailable methods remain visible. Context traces record included evidence, exclusions and a snapshot hash.
search.unavailable: This method is unavailable. No substitute result was claimed.

review.noConflicts: No conflicting values were returned by the current checks.
review.observationNotice: Recorded observations describe an image. Approval reviews this record; it does not verify technical product properties from appearance.
review.decorative: Decorative images use an empty alt attribute. Essential information belongs in visible content.
review.functional: Describe the action or destination, not just the image's appearance.
review.jsonldHint: Structured data is generated from current authoritative fields. Missing price, currency, availability or variant data is reported rather than invented.
review.subject: Subject identifier
review.jsonldUnavailable: Product JSON-LD is blocked until the required current authoritative fields are available.
review.signin: Sign in as a reviewer or owner to approve image reviews and relationships.
review.scopeMismatch: The returned evidence belongs to a different product. Refresh before reviewing.

shopify.unconfigured: Shopify application credentials are not configured. Connection and sync are disabled; no store is connected by this interface.
shopify.signin: Sign in with connector-management permission to manage a store.
shopify.deleteConfirm: Retire imported evidence from active retrieval and delete connector credentials/cache. Historical source revisions, audit records and backups retain provenance.
shopify.readOnly: Read-only integration. These controls do not publish product changes.
shopify.unsafeRedirect: The server returned an invalid authorization destination.

benchmark.title: Measure methods against the frozen corpus.
benchmark.description: Results describe this versioned corpus. Synthetic expected labels require independent human review before they qualify as accepted quality evidence.
benchmark.confirmation: I inspected every selected question and image label, including expected source, abstention, image purpose and alt text, and recorded corrections below.
benchmark.signin: A signed-in reviewer or owner is required to record human review.
benchmark.emptySelection: Select the exact labels you inspected.
benchmark.recorded: Human review record saved. Dataset acceptance still depends on the recorded coverage and decision.
benchmark.notImage: Image artifact unavailable at an allowed local path. Inspect the identified source artifact before reviewing.
benchmark.caseResults: Full measured report and question outcomes
benchmark.missingContext: No usage context was supplied. Purpose requires contextual review.
